attributes.name: Spellcharger Leather
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to reduce Acid, Combat, or Electricity damage dealt to you by 3.

Recharge this card to add 1d8 to your check to recharge a spell.

Banish this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you to 0

If proficient with light armors, banish this card to reduce Acid or Electricity damage dealt to you to 0.

If proficient with light armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
